WELCOME TO KIDDO.SCHOOL

Their first school
starts with you.

A learning journey from baby’s first look onward — simple classes, playful activities and gentle guidance for parents along the way.

Kiddo.school is a digital school for little kids: age-guided classes from birth, hands-on classrooms as they grow, and short parent-led sessions that fit real life. No sign-up, no pressure — age ranges are a guide, not a test.

HOW SCHOOL WORKS

Little classes. Real life. Together.

01

Learn

A short class on screen: a few cards, one idea, your voice doing the teaching.

02

Play

Toddlers tap, find and match. Wrong taps are welcome — there are no scores here.

03

Explore

Follow what catches their eye. There is no finish line to reach.

04

Take it off screen

Every class ends in real life: hunt for red, spot a circle, name it together.

05

Continue tomorrow

A new little class whenever it suits you. Short and often wins.

A LITTLE PRACTICE, A LOT OF POSSIBILITY

Your very own writing space.

Trace a letter, practise your name, or fill the page with ideas. Choose a colour and write with your finger, stylus or mouse.

TRY IT
RIGHT HERE
Pen colour

Start at the top. Down one side, down the other, then across.

Use paper and a pencil to follow the practice prompt.

Ready when you are. There is no score—just room to practise.

Writing stays on this device and disappears when you refresh or close the page. Save your picture to keep it. Changing the activity starts a new page; Undo restores the previous marks. Prefer paper? Copy the prompt into a notebook and draw there.

FROM THE ACTIVITY WALL

Ready, set, create!

All 11 activities ↗

Grow a bean

Ages 6–1220 min + daily check-ins

Watch roots and shoots appear, then draw the changes in your own bean diary.

Make a shape collage

Ages 3–825 min

Tear, arrange and layer colourful paper to make a picture that is entirely your own.

Make a repeating pattern

Ages 3–815 min

Turn big paper shapes into repeating patterns and challenge someone to find your rule.

GROW AT YOUR OWN PACE

FOR PARENTS

You are the teacher.
